description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different datasets used in the experiments, with a total of five categories. The largest category is TriviaQA, comprising 46% of the dataset, followed by WebQA at 25%, HalluEval at 18%, Chinese Domain at 6%, and the smallest category is HalluQA at 5%. Each slice is color-coded and labeled with both the name of the dataset and the corresponding percentage and number of instances. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and does not appear to emphasize any particular slice over the others. The slices are ordered by size, with TriviaQA being the largest and HalluQA the smallest.
